{{Youmay|one of several well-know (or notorious) street bazaars on Coruscant|[[Market (disambiguation)|other uses of the word]]}}
'''Ploughtekal Market''' was a sprawling, multi-level market in the [[Zi-Kree Sector]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It contained both permanent storefronts and temporary stalls selling virtually anything. The levels of the market were connected by a network of well-hidden access tubes that made escape possible when the authorities put in an appearance.

Ploughtekal was a place of dark shadow and neon gleam, thick smells, and torrential sound. It was Babel, with the languages of a hundred worlds entwined, woven together with Basic. It never slept.
